answer: Standing decays four percent per epoch without an answer, and any attempt to link two identities resets both to zero. Quorums must span unrelated subnetworks, so no panel can be seated from one rack. One operator ran sixty keys from a single slash twenty-four and the decay cost eleven percent of score per day while the subnet rule disqualified every panel those keys drew, so sixty keys settled zero answers in nine epochs. The vertex is the reset point. An oasis that never refills is a hole, and one vine shades nothing.
